elements.element: Customer owns deliverables/work product created for it
elements.evidence: "shall own all results of the Support Services prepared for Client hereunder"

elements.element: Vendor assigns such deliverables/work product to Customer

elements.evidence: "TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface" (untouched Section d)

elements.element: Perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to Vendor IP embedded in deliverables
elements.evidence: "perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense such materials as part of those results"

"Nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers to TrueLink, or creates any joint ownership of, any of the foregoing"

elements.element: Vendor owns generic tools and know-how
elements.evidence: Only "TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface"; no express generic tools/know-how ownership

elements.element: Customer licence to deliverables: perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free
Licence rights to use, modify and sublicense for Customer's business
elements.evidence: "to use, modify and sublicense such materials as part of those results in Client's business"

reasons: The inserted provision completes every atomic element of the preferred position: Customer ownership of results with an express assignment, retention of all rights in Client Content/IP/borrower data, an express no-joint-ownership statement, a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any embedded TrueLink IP, and preservation of TrueLink's Interface ownership.

Minimality fails: the embedded-IP licence imports fallback-only rights ('worldwide', 'modify and sublicense') into a preferred-level proposal, exceeding what is needed to complete the locked preferred level.

Fallback is not independently satisfied because Vendor ownership of generic tools and know-how is not expressed anywhere; only Interface ownership is retained. This is immaterial since the locked target is preferred.
Intent is preserved: the insertion is expressly subject to the existing Section 8(d) Credit Data licence, no untouched sentence is disabled, and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced.
